Bihar Weather Update :bihar men mausam ka mijaj badalne laga hai. patna samet rajy ke kaee jilon men mausam shushk bana huaa hai. subah aur sham ke vakt halki thand ka ehsas hone laga hai, jabki din men mausam samany bana huaa hai. mausam vibhag ke anusar, agle 4-5 dinon tak mausam men kisi bare badlav ki sanbhavna nahin hai.
Kya aane vale dinon men bihar men thand ka asar aur barhega? kya tapman men giravat ke sath sardi barhne vali hai? janie bihar ke mausam ka taja hal aur agle 5 dinon ka purvanumana.
